title: Blue Dragon Girl
description: A young woman with short silver hair featuring a blue streak stands in a dynamic pose against a solid pink background. She wears a form-fitting blue armored outfit with glowing neon lines, matching blue boots and gloves, and has a long blue dragon tail with a spiked tip and a dragon-like shoulder piece.
prompt: A confident young woman with short silver hair and a bright blue streak stands in a dynamic three-quarter pose against a solid hot pink background. She wears intricate blue armored bodice and pants with glowing cyan neon lines, blue gauntlets, heavy blue boots, and has a long scaly blue dragon tail with a blade-like tip. A stylized blue dragon head rests on her shoulder. She has a slight smile and visible scar on her cheek, digital painting style, highly detailed, vibrant colors
